mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES mobility from t-2w to t-0w signals more weekday activity near commercial areas, which raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as lunch and after-work shopping recover.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -26.6 at t-2w to -21.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays flat or falls while RETAIL_REC still rises over the next 28 days, this commuting-led retail mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility is elevated and nearby destination mobility stays weak, people substitute toward home-based routines and discretionary retail visits remain suppressed, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL remained above baseline at 10.9 to 12.7 while RETAIL_REC stayed around -27 to -31
failure_condition: If elevated RESIDENTIAL is followed by a higher RETAIL_REC average over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days, the home-substitution mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A cross-week decline in TRANSIT below its recent level reduces access to shopping districts and shortens discretionary trips, causing RETAIL_REC to weaken within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -35 after having been above -35 in the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -35.0 at t-1w and -32.9 at t-0w after -37.7 at t-2w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT drops through the specified threshold but RETAIL_REC does not fall within the next 14 days, the transit-access mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM indicates more multi-stop local outings and neighborhood traffic, which spills over into retail visits and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS recovered from -31.1 at t-1w to -23.4 at t-0w while GROCERY_PHARM stayed near -5
failure_condition: If PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM rise together for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC does not improve over the following 28 days, the spillover hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS mobility remains depressed for several weeks, it signals weak outdoor demand and low discretionary outing intensity, which keeps RETAIL_REC below its recent average over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS stays below -20 for at least two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was -16.9, -20.0, -31.1, and -23.4 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS remains below -20 for two weeks but RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days, the outdoor-demand suppression mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A narrowing gap between WORKPLACES and TRANSIT means commuting is resuming faster than in-vehicle visits, which initially channels more workers through retail corridors and raises RETAIL_REC within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both moved upward at t-0w, with TRANSIT less depressed than at t-1w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES recovers while TRANSIT does not narrow its gap and RETAIL_REC still rises within one week, the commuter-corridor mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: Under a stable restriction regime, persistent weakness in TRANSIT combined with subdued WORKPLACES keeps city-center circulation low, so retail-and-recreation demand trends down over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stayed near -33 to -38 and WORKPLACES near -22 to -27 across the snapshot
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain weak for four weeks but RETAIL_REC nonetheless exceeds its prior four-week mean, the circulation-suppression mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run improvement in GROCERY_PHARM before a retail recovery signals renewed routine outings and errand bundling, which pushes RETAIL_REC higher over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM improves by at least 2 points from one week to the next
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM moved from -7.4 at t-1w to -5.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: If a week-over-week improvement in GROCERY_PHARM of at least 2 points is not followed by higher RETAIL_REC within 14 days, the errand-bundling mechanism fails.
